services.desc: Beautifully restored, Asbury Hall comes complete with a state of the art sound system, fixed stage, original wrap around balcony with pew seating. If you are looking for something more cozy our smaller room, The 9th Ward, has rich wood, stone walls, and a fixed bar featuring the original church altar. Both Asbury Hall and the 9th Ward are available for private rental. Weddings, charity events, art shows, live television tapings, holiday parties, reunions, memorials, dance performances, plays - we are available for both small and large
